tha-ap246:1.1: Viravapupphiya.] Khīṇāsavasahassena niyyāti lokanāyako / viravapupphaṃ paggayha Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap246:2.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap246:4.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Viravapupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
